profile.headline: Web, eCommerce, Apps Developer  |  Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Stephen Rivera, is founder and president of LogoGraphica, and has over 20 years experience with enterprise level Web & Mobile Design, Programming, iPhone & Android Apps and Graphics Design.  Mr. Rivera has served as Senior Developer for Office Depot, Gtech, IBM, Cybear, Royal Caribbean, Corning Inc., NCCI, Weiss Research, among others…

"I have been the lead developer and project leader for many large scale IT & Web projects with 500+ users, did enterprise level programming and web development for NCCI, IBM, Corning Inc., Office Depot, and Royal Caribbean, and have served over 100 clients worldwide." - SGR

Computer Languages:
WordPress vet developer, Php/MySql, JavaScript, JNode,  SmartyTemplates, JQuery, ASP.NET, VB.NET, PHP 5/CGI,  MS Sql Server and Oracle Data Modeling, SQL syntax and Stored Procedures, DHTML, XML, some C, some Visual C++, Visual FoxPro 6, some Pascal, working knowledge of Unix admin, some Java development. High level Flash, Dreamweaver, & Photoshop proficiency...

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description: LogoGraphica provides Enterprise Level Web & Mobile Design, Programming, iPhone & Android Apps and Graphics Design, commercial websites, e-Commerce shopping carts, 3d animations, and custom applications using PHP, DHTML, ASP.Net, JavaScript, and Visual Basic 6. Custom applications for several clients using PHP/MySql, ASP, ASP.Net, SQL Server 2000, Javascript. Hosting websites and all facets of graphic design, logo design, and web optimization. Google, Paypal, Authorize.net Certified Developer, SEO, SEM, Android, and iPhone app development.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description:
Entrada Technologies - 2000 Palm Beach Lakes Blvd., West Palm Beach, FL

Designed “Direct To Distributor” type applications for the beverage industry using ASP .Net, Java and Visual Basic on Pocket PCs, Palm Pilots using VB, ASP, ASP.Net, SQL Server 2k,Javascript. Heavy Sql Server development using stored procedures and agents for Data Modeling the business rules and merge replication on Hand Held units, Was the lead developer for their flagship product, Route Warrior.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Burns Road, Palm Beach Gardens, FL
positions.description: Created Key financial programs, Intranet applications, and Internet applications using VB, ASP, ASP.Net, SQL Server 2k, Javascript and PHP scripts. Porting all FoxPro tables into SQLServer, connecting to legacy FoxPro tables. Managed three programmers and was responsible for the project's timelines and efficiency for the company.

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.locationName: Yamato Road, IBM Building, Boca Raton, FL
positions.description:
Was responsible for the design & development of: - Installer - A visual Basic application that installs the autodialer and determines if the user has a valid internet connection. If the user has not yet setup an ISP, the program will automatically create a Dialup object using Cybear's own ISP properties to connect.
- Cold Fusion to ASP Conversion: Used DNA architecture to migrate the existing Cold Fusion web site into Active Server Pages. - WebMail - Used DNA architecture to create a complete, full featured Web Based Email System (similar to Yahoo Mail) using Three Tier Architecture, ASP and JavaScript Front end for Presentation Layer , Visual Basic DLL for User Services, Oracle PL/SQL Stored Procedures for the Data Services.... Replaced the Cold Fusion based email and runs 20x faster than original. Used Easymail Objects 5 for SMTP, Imail 5.0 as Mail Server. - Email Import - Routine in Visual Basic that imported all the Oracle based email messages and exported those as SMTP standard messages into the new Imail Server.

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst
positions.description: Designed and deployed key Intranet and Internet applications: E-Notes (Calculations, Query builder, OLC, Audits), ComPoint Application. Saved several projects by redefining what technologies to use and replacing the ones that were not working (RDS, DDCS) . Have mentored successfully a group of mainframe programmers which are now coding ASP/Intranet applications. Established the use of technologies such as 3 Tiered Architecture, Microsoft DNA, MTS, COM, JavaScript. Have received "Exceeds Expectations" reviews and served as the Web Development "Subject Matter Expert" to many departments

positions.title: Lead Internet Developer
positions.description: Created & Coded Flashnet: Thin client application that polls all cruise ships for revenue data, imports into an Oracle database, then publishes the data in report format as an ASP page that will also generate Bar charts to show revenue trends. All thin client, 3 tier client/server systems in leading edge technologies including ASP, JavaScript, DHTML, Java Applets, ActiveX DLL, Isapi filters, and implementing MTS with DCOM for all remote objects.
